Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the slaughter, preparation, and sale of certain chickens.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to exempting the slaughter, preparation, and saleof certain chickens from the state's food processing act; and amendingRCW 69.07.100.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 69.07.100 and 2002 c 301 s 10 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The provisions of this chapter shall not apply toestablishments issued a permit or licensed under the provisions of: (((1))) (a) Chapter 69.25 RCW, the Washington wholesome eggs andegg products act; (((2))) (b) Chapter 69.28 RCW, the Washington state honey act; (((3))) (c) Chapter 16.49 RCW, the meat inspection act; (((4))) (d) Chapter 77.65 RCW, relating to the direct retailendorsement for wildcaught seafood; (((5))) (e) Title 66 RCW, relating to alcoholic beverage control;and (((6))) (f) Chapter 69.30 RCW, the sanitary control of shellfish p. 1 HB 1125act. However, if any such establishments process foods notspecifically provided for in the above entitled acts, suchestablishments shall be subject to the provisions of this chapter. (2) The provisions of this chapter shall not apply to: (a) Restaurants or food service establishments; and (b) The slaughter and preparation of one thousand or fewer chickensin a calendar year by the agricultural producer of the chickens for thesale of the whole or cutup raw chickens by the producer directly toretail customers.
